descriptions.text: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

The Liam Marcus Firm of Comfortable Protections added a layer of MaxiAlloy-weave, surrounded by a TwinFiber Super-line. The result was remarkable, and was very well received. This makes the improved Shogun face-guard a rare item.

descriptions.text: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

descriptions.text: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.
